subject: Saturday garage plan update
text: Quick note about Saturday: as your neighbor and shift-mate, I still plan to meet you at the community garage at nine, but I had to change my budget after the water heater service. The plumber caught a corroded valve during the emergency visit, and the part plus after-hours labor turned a routine call into a bigger bill than I expected. Because of that, I'll skip the downtown cafe stop and we can bring coffee from home. If you want, I can grab two boxes of bagels from the corner bakery before we start sorting the boxes; they're cheaper than the artisan shop and still good enough for a work morning. I'll wear old shoes and bring the dolly, the big trash bags, and the roll of packing tape. You can focus on labeling and setting aside anything that still smells usable for the food pantry. We should finish by two unless the storage unit turns out worse than you warned me. Afterward, no dinner out for me, but I can swing by for a beer and chips if you're staying late. Let me know tonight if you still want me to park at the side entrance, since I'll be carrying the heavy cart and don't want to block the bay. Thanks for covering the early shift yesterday; I'll keep the Saturday plan as low-fuss as possible so the extra cost doesn't turn into extra hassle.
